name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_set_raw_keyboard_capture
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::SetRawKeyboardCapture toggles raw keyboard callback capture for the numeric input.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4b4c50 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4b4c50 validates early return when the requested enable byte matches sliderVisibleWhenInputActive, otherwise storing the byte and installing HudUiNumericTextInput::RawKeyboardCallback/self or clearing the callback/context.
The native smoke verifies no-change, enable, and disable cases through g_zInput_KbdRawEventCallback and g_zInput_KbdRawEventCallbackCtx.
